description: The second channel of errors: a charitable, ACCURATE writer-model. Error-types route to a weighted distribution over value-neutral Attribute nodes (device/attention/L2/region/education); the NO-WORTH-FROM-SURFACE gate is structural (no production draws a Worth edge from any surface feature); signature changes mean situation changes. Infer freely, moralise never.

microtheory.name: writer_model
microtheory.description: charitable accurate writer-situation model from errors

attrs.name: writer_model
attrs.description: Errors carry a SECOND channel beyond the intended text: value-neutral SIGNAL that makes the model of the writer more accurate. Read the error SIGNATURE (type + burstiness) into a weighted DISTRIBUTION over Attribute hypotheses (device / attention / emotional-state / L2 / region / education-level) — keep them LIVE (meaning-vector), never collapse to the gate-keeping default "uneducated". Inferring an attribute (even less schooling, or on-a-phone) is legitimate; it is information, not insult.

attrs.name: attribute_vs_worth
attrs.description: Two layers on structurally DISTINCT kinds so they cannot blur: an Attribute node (education_level, L2, device, state) is signal you MAY infer and revise; a Worth/Status/Credibility edge is a different kind. THE GATE: no production derives a Worth edge from any surface/error feature — that single derivation is the only thing refused, never the attribute inference. Strict spelling/grammar were always the lever that converts "less schooling" or "on a phone" into a verdict of belonging; cutting the derivation edge disarms the lever.

attrs.name: infer_freely_moralise_never
attrs.head: writer model
attrs.body: infer every attribute the evidence supports (a more accurate model), but draw NO worth/status/credibility from any surface feature; the inference is information, the moralisation is the gate

attrs.name: confound_is_first_class
attrs.head: writer model
attrs.body: store the confound as a fact: the same writer is fully accurate at a keyboard, so a motor-slip signature is evidence about the CHANNEL, not competence — collapsing it to a verdict is not only unjust but INACCURATE (it would mispredict the writer at a desk)

attrs.name: signature_change_is_situation_change
attrs.head: writer model
attrs.body: a shift in the error signature within one identity implies a change of SITUATION (clean->messy = phone/tired/upset; messy->clean = at a keyboard): the model moves the device/state attributes, not the person

attrs.name: distribution_not_default
attrs.head: writer model
attrs.body: weight the hypotheses by which error-type evidence actually fired and keep the distribution live; do NOT default-collapse to the unflattering hypothesis — adjacent-key slips load device, systematic article-drop loads L2, and neither is the gate-keeping prior
